item_placement.method: populate-pickups: copy arr-lockbox-pickup-offsets; 4 times pick a random remaining offset (removed after use) and spawn-entity-at(item spawner, offset-locator(object-locator(crate), offset)); 2 spawns come from grp-lockbox-ammo-pickups and 2 from grp-lockbox-craft-mats-pickups (decompiler folds the counters: ammo index 0,1; mats index continues after the ammo ones, unconfirmed whether 0,1 or 2,3)
item_placement.random_ammo_template: pickup-template-ammo (ammo for the weapons the player carries)

post_spawn_fixups.arrows/bolts: locator = crate + (0, 0.38, 0.10) rotated 90 deg about local Y
post_spawn_fixups.pistol magazines: rotated 90 about X then 90 about Y
post_spawn_fixups.ingredients (alcohol, canisters, bottles: offset +(0.06 wood | 0.03 military, 0, 0), rotate 270 about X then 90 about Z (lie flat)

suggested_12_slot_layout_for_our_itempos._note: our box has 12 itempos slots (2013); NR has 4. Same cloth rectangle, y = 0.40 (cloth top 0.394). This is NOT an NR number.

open.events: 3 x sound-effect at clip start: sfx-t2r-igc-loot-crate-open-hinge@lid, -latch@latch, -lid@root

crate_clips.open-partial / open-wood-partial: declared in the script, in no clip pak: unused

animation.script_open_sequence: event player-requested-interact -> interactable-disable, player-save-action-time(listen-mode-supplies); state opened-lockbox. Track player: broadcast-event(lockbox-opened), log-event('supply-drop','opened'), player-simulate-pickup(crate locator + (0,0.5,0), 1,0,0,1). Track crate: wait 0.50 s, animate_(crate, open|open-wood, [param 10 = crate locator, param 28 = blend 0.30]), wait 0.10, signal(box-opened). Track loot: wait-for(box-opened), lockbox-unopened=false, cleanup-pickups, populate-pickups (4 pickups), listen-mode-set-buddy-draw-mode(crate,0), listen-mode-visible(crate,0,1,-1), high-contrast 1 (opened look), marker cleared. Track haptics: play-hfx-id(unlock-crate-haptic,0,2) after box-opened.

after: EVT dynamic-state-data signal-pickup=1 (+50 ms after the crate sounds)
EVT bp-effect scav-insert-item joint=spineb -> SND sfx-backpack-abby-scav-insert-item (+0.38..0.74 s after the crate sounds)
player_clips_observed_sp_run_1025.note: the pickup clip comes from the locator height (player-simulate-pickup); the crate lid is animated by the prop, the player plays no scripted full-body open for this crate

hub_crate_full_body_open (ss-hub-lockbox.timing_sp_1030: open-start -> crate sounds +1.95 s -> idle +1.5 s -> idle--grab (+0.05 s) -> open-end +1.85 s after the grab

interactable.spawn: spawn-entity-at(int-mp-crate-military-1, get-joint-locator(crate, interact)); parent-bound-frame to the crate
interactable.marker: hud/interactions/marker-lootbox.png via hud-buddy-status/rogue-attachable while listen mode is on (or for 7.5 s after the spawn)

sounds.bank: obj-dead-drops (aud-sfx-dead-drop.bin, common-objects; sfx-info-light category igc-sfx). Loaded by t2r-rewards-chest-crates-skel SOUND_BANK_TABLE and by the base 'starlight-mp-test' lines of our pak68 (tools/sp_parity/sound_audit.py)
sounds.hud_voice: HUD_ROGUE_WAVE_COMPLETED spoken at the recovery start; pause card *t2r-rogue-tutorial-supply-drop*
sounds.sp_trace_timing: the three crate sounds fall in one frame, 0.35 s after the pickup gesture starts (script: wait 0.5 s after the interact event) = clip frame 0; box-opened signal and listen-mode remove 0.10 s later

spawn_logic.when: state assault-recovery-phase start (after each wave while waves remain): broadcast-event(spawn-lockbox)
spawn_logic.where: get-lockbox-spawner: first spawner of grp-lockbox-locations (tag rogue-lockbox-spawner) that is NOT on screen with a clear view, 10 m < distance to player < 1000 m and spawn-loc-clear? (spherecast r 0.8, 0.1 m up, hits nothing); else group-random; the used spawner is removed (no repeat)
spawn_logic.after_spawn: enable-nav-blocker-object, disable-cover-aps-in-sphere(pos, 1.5), set-high-contrast-mode-type 2, rogue-mark-always-visible-in-listen-mode, log-event('supply-drop','spawned'), 7.5 s marker timer (non-siege)
spawn_logic.variants: encounter-tweaks +100: 1 military (default), 2 wood-a, 3 wood-b; spawner tag is-wooden forces wood-a; wood crates use open-wood / close-wood
spawn_logic.siege_mode: spawn-all-lockbox: every siege-lockbox-loc-0..3 spawner gets a crate at once

our_ext.approach: dress the stock box: spawn-object rl-cache-crate-military (SimpleAttachable) at each winmm box-table spawner (0x18013A4A8: +0 hash, +0x14 opened flag), set-object-locator, mirror the opened flag with animate_ open/close
